title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) vehicle procurement for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (2028…
text:
[Council File 26-0600-S111]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) vehicle procurement for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (2028 Games).
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the City Administrative Officer (CAO) report dated September 28, 2026, attached to the Council file, relative to the LAPD’s request for Municipal Improvement Corporation of Los Angeles (MICLA) financing for 300 dual-purpose vehicles, as the CAO's Office does not recommend the procurement of additional vehicles for the 2028 Games.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable. Financial policies The CAO reports that the recommendation in the report is in compliance with the statement City's Financial Policies.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Ad Hoc Committee on the 2028 Olympics and Paralympic Games has waived consideration of this matter.)
summary: Files the CAO's recommendation against buying 300 more dual-purpose LAPD vehicles for the 2028 Olympics, which would have been financed through MICLA.

details.action: note and file of LAPD vehicle financing request
